title: On analyzing and evaluating privacy measures for social networks under active attack
reasoning: The paper investigates and evaluates 'privacy violation measures' for social networks. While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper's focus is on the technical, mathematical, and algorithmic quantification of these measures (k-metric antidimension, (k,l)-anonymity) and their computational complexities, rather than on evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or faith/religious systems directly as a core component.
